sources.note: The direct filed PDF states that StepStone ATS became a direct owner of a ten-percent-or-greater voting interest in SIP after OTPPB transferred part of its indirect interest, while OTPPB remained an ultimate upstream affiliate. It names StepStone Group Real Assets as manager. The filing supplies material voting-owner relationships but not exact percentages or SIP's complete passive and sub-ten-percent owner set.

sources.label: STRUCTURE schedule
sources.note: The June 30, 2026 direct StepStone Private Infrastructure Fund schedule classifies SIP under non-controlled/non-affiliated direct equity and reports 4,115,226 Series C preferred units acquired 2026-03-16, $80 million cost and $116.6 million fair value; footnote 6 says all or part is held by STRUCTURE Sidewalk LLC. It does not disclose issuer ownership percentage, votes or the complete SIP cap table.

sources.label: SPRIM schedule
sources.note: The June 30, 2026 direct StepStone Private Markets schedule classifies SIP under non-controlled/non-affiliated direct equity and reports 2,572,016 Series C preferred units acquired 2026-03-16, $50 million cost and $72.9 million fair value; footnote 10 says all or part is held by SPRIM Sidewalk LLC. It does not disclose issuer ownership percentage, votes or the complete SIP cap table.

exactException: Sidewalk Infrastructure Partners is one active U.S. infrastructure holding and development platform, and direct evidence contradicts the production record's sole-OTPP presentation. The July 2025 FERC filing proves StepStone ATS as a direct holder of at least ten percent of voting interests after an OTPPB transfer and confirms OTPPB remained upstream; June 2026 SEC schedules prove two additional direct Series C positions. The public record still omits passive and sub-ten-percent holders, anonymous Form D purchasers, exact classes and percentages for material voting holders, and all 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-05 transfers. It therefore cannot certify the complete cutoff member set, exact stakes, votes or control or safely support a partial ownership after-image.
conclusion: DEFERRED. Preserve the verified exact LLC identity, one-platform boundary and contradiction of sole-OTPP ownership as research lineage. Make no owner, vehicle, fund, stake, status, database or seed mutation until a certified cutoff member or securities register and complete capitalization and transfer records resolve SIP's full current ownership.
